# Round75 synthetic XML/Excel regression

`round75-xml-formula-regression.test.cjs` contains only fictional XML and synthetic cache values, testing UTF-16 XML, exact carriage-return serialization, and formula-error-versus-literal-error behavior. No real player workbook, player name, archival data or extracted sheet is included. The real-file roundtrip is performed privately and is not asserted as a public CI result.
